title: Record register 39 from the fault through the last event
body:
## Summary
- From event 24438 through event 26098, register 39 has one scalar value change when register 359 starts at `1`. The fault addition takes it from `-4` to `0`.
- Five later additions name the same register. Their sources hold `0`, so each contribution is `0`, and the value remains `0`. The data register contributes `0`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The sources of those zero contributions are not traced.
